metric: Pairs shown different by a constraint-respecting database on which both queries were run (DuckDB), and pairs on which 600 random databases (and every database of at most 2 rows per table) showed no difference (not a proof, not bounded verification).
correctness: Every refutation was executed on both queries, is stable under row-order shuffles, and shows with DuckDB's optimizer off too; none are claimed without a database
caveats: No labels. 29 pairs are not run because DuckDB rejects their Calcite-only syntax (LATERAL, SINGLE_VALUE and similar). One pair (a correlated EXISTS with an unqualified column) is read differently by DuckDB than by VeriEQL. Rules were developed against SQLSolver's Calcite pairs, which overlap this suite (tuned on test). In this row 'unknown' counts pairs that agree on every database tried and 'unsupported' counts pairs DuckDB or the parser rejects.
